description:
Installs only with dry_run=false; by default it reports what would be installed and installs nothing.
Installs an APK from the server's file roots (file_roots). apk_path takes a single .apk, an array of split-APK paths, or one .apks/.xapk/.apkm bundle.
Without apk_path it installs nothing and lists the installable files in file_roots, newest first, with the full path to pass as apk_path: start there when the user says "install what I downloaded".
Bundle splits are chosen from the device ABI list, density and locale. No matching ABI split is a refusal; a density mismatch is not.
Flags -r, -t and -g are applied by default. The reverse is adb_uninstall, or adb_app for a removal with a backup and a rollback.

abi.description: Bundle only: force an ABI instead of the device default (e.g. armeabi-v7a)

apk_path.description: Single APK path, array of split-APK paths, or one .apks/.xapk/.apkm bundle. Without it: a list of the installable files in file_roots, newest first; nothing is installed.

density.description: Bundle only: force a screen density in dpi instead of the device value

dir.description: Only without apk_path: the list shows the top level and one level of subfolders; for a deeper folder pass it here, listed the same way. Ignored when apk_path is given.

dry_run.description: Default true: report the files, the command and the device (for a bundle, also the chosen splits) and install nothing. Only false installs.

locales.description: Bundle only: extra language splits to include alongside the device language (e.g. ["ru"] on an en-US device)

serial.description: Device serial from adb_devices. Optional when exactly one device is connected.

name: adb_install
title: Install app
